dataset_acquisition: Public Hugging Face datasets-server rows endpoint, verified row counts; downloaded locally and transferred because server endpoint had no network route.

protocol.corpus_text: (title + " " + text).strip(); dataset has no title field
protocol.query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a query, retrieve documents that answer the query
Query: {query}
protocol.qrels: 244 binary positive judgments, no extra exclusions
protocol.score: dot product of normalized embeddings (cosine); full corpus scored, top 1000 retained
protocol.metric: mean pytrec_eval ndcg_cut_10, rounded to 5 decimals then multiplied by 100
protocol.metric_crosscheck: Every query checked against independent DCG/IDCG formula; equal scores ordered by descending document ID
protocol.b1_comparison: B1 is a speed/control run; padding causes its input token sequences to differ from B4

server_artifacts: Full embedding arrays remain in each run probe/embeddings.npz; hashes and byte counts in result.json; other benchmark outputs preserved in Git.
